questions.q: Metals found at the bottom of the activity series (e.g., gold, silver, platinum) are typically found in nature in which state?
questions.explain: Metals like gold, silver, and platinum are least reactive. Because they have very low reactivity, they do not easily combine with other elements and thus exist in their free (native) state in nature.
